claim: Design section 4: mix needs all five skills, including applying zone entries, withdrawals and ties when reading.
note: OBSERVED: p1 publishes raw reports in time order and makes no register reads; it answers from its own report times and the fixed question positions. INFERRED: the reader skill is replaced by a generator regularity, and the writer's tie resolution is delegated to peers. V3: stop instead of raising an exception when a time or key is absent from the original lookup.
